title: Julius Caesar to Sonic through 266 popes
description: Rome's first emperors, a Renaissance fresco, the line of popes, a Vatican audience and The Tonight Show connect Julius Caesar to Sonic the Hedgehog.
hook: How is Julius Caesar connected to Sonic the Hedgehog?

links.line: From Peter, the line of popes runs unbroken to the 266th, Pope Francis.
In 2024, Pope Francis invited over a hundred comedians to the Vatican, and shook hands with Jimmy Fallon.
Two months later, Fallon welcomed actor Ben Schwartz onto The Tonight Show.
And since 2020, Ben Schwartz has been the voice of Sonic in the Sonic the Hedgehog movies.
